explication: This repository is a set of inference entry points for CogView4 and CogView3-Plus text-to-image models, plus prompt-refinement tools. Users either submit prompts through the Gradio demo or run a command-line demo; the scripts call Diffusers pipelines and return or save generated images. The web demo also offers LLM-based prompt enhancement, while the standalone optimizer supports CogView3 and CogView4 prompt formats. The graph captures sampled calls and README capabilities; training and ControlNet code are not present in the tree.
